title: CytoNet: A Foundation Model for the Human Cerebral Cortex at Cellular Resolution
abstract: arXiv:2511.01870v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Studying the cellular architecture of the human cerebral cortex is essential for understanding how the brain is organized from the micro to the macro level, and how it functions. However, investigating complex texture patterns in histological images using automatic methods that can be scaled across whole brains remains a challenge. Here we introduce CytoNet, a foundation model trained on 1 million unlabeled microscopic image patches from over 4,000 histological sections from nine postmortem brains, and evaluated on over 2,000 sections from five additional brains excluded from self-supervised pretraining. Using co-localization in the cortical sheet for self-supervision, CytoNet learns to encode complex cellular patterns into expressive and anatomically meaningful feature representations. translated_title: CytoNet：人类大脑皮层细胞分辨率的基础模型
translated_abstract: 摘要：研究人类大脑皮层的细胞结构对于理解大脑从微观到宏观的组织方式及其功能至关重要。然而，使用可扩展至全脑范围的自动方法研究组织学图像中的复杂纹理模式仍然是一个挑战。在此，我们引入了CytoNet，这是一个基础模型，在来自9个死后大脑的4000多个组织学切片中的100万个未标记显微镜图像块上进行训练，并在排除自监督预训练之外的5个额外大脑的2000多个切片上进行评估。利用皮层片层中的共定位进行自监督，CytoNet学会将复杂的细胞模式编码为具有表现力和解剖学意义的特征表示。CytoNet支持多种下游应用，包括区域分类、层状分割、微结构变异量化等。
tldr: CytoNet通过自监督学习利用皮层共定位，在细胞分辨率下编码复杂细胞模式，为大脑皮层组织学分析提供了可扩展的基础模型，支持区域分类和层状分割等任务。
en_tdlr: CytoNet leverages cortical co-localization for self-supervised learning to encode complex cellular patterns at cellular resolution, providing a scalable foundation model for histological analysis of the cerebral cortex, enabling tasks like area classification and laminar segmentation.
